elements.label: Philanthropy's Promise
elements.description: The invisible hand, in its inscrutable wisdom, guides the resources of the world towards the betterment of all. Its touch brings prosperity, its movement ensures growth. For fortune, invoke it. For wealth, obey its unseen nudges.

slots.label: With
slots.description: Study with a Hand lore fragment of the same level to upgrade to the next level. Study with Lantern lore of the same level to subvert it, and get Lantern lore instead.

elements.label: Capital's Whisper
elements.description: In the silent halls of commerce, secrets are traded like currency. Listen well, and you may discern the whisper of the invisible hand, nudging fortunes, bending probabilities. This is the language of wealth, the lexicon of power.

slots.label: With
slots.description: Study with a Hand lore fragment of the same level to upgrade to the next level. Study with Lantern lore of the same level to subvert it, and get Lantern lore instead. Or study with Reason to break the lore into lower-level fragments.

elements.label: The Gilded Paradox
elements.description: The invisible hand bestows and takes away in equal measure. Its touch can turn lead to gold and riches to ruin. Its benevolence masks a riddle: What is gained in loss? This Paradox holds the key.

elements.label: Automaton Warnings
elements.description: The Berserker Probes, tirelessly working in the shadows, are the hands of the Hand. Their unseen manipulations, their relentless resource gathering, hold a cryptic caution. These warnings, however, are not for us.

elements.label: Cosmic Puppeteer's Testament
elements.description: An alien entity pulls the strings of the invisible hand, orchestrating a cosmic puppet show. It finds new homes in unsuspecting worlds, twisting economies and societies. This is its testament, a silent declaration of purpose.

elements.label: Harvester's Revelation
elements.description: The harvester of worlds has set its gaze on us. It wears down the strength of humanity, bides its time for the harvest. The Hand, in its enigmatic gestures, betrays this dark revelation.

elements.label: The Terminal Transaction
elements.description: The invisible hand has always been at work, dealing in the commerce of despair, trading in doom. It leads us towards the end, a final transaction where everything is lost, and the harvester claims its due. This is the grim story of our inevitable capitulation.
